result.brief: 提出从单目视频构建可探索、随时间变化的4D音视频场景，重建动态发声物体轨迹并同步扩散生成空间声场，支持实时新视角视觉与空间音频渲染。
result.reason: Builds a time-varying 4D audio-visual scene from one video with diffusion synchronization, spatial sound field synthesis and novel-view rendering; 4D environment modeling plus joint audio-visual generation.
